lines.text: Kal exam hai. Notes ready hain. Par ek sawaal ka jawab — notes mein hai kya?
Generic chatbot poochho to turant jawab. Confident. Aur aadha jhooth — kyunki usne tumhare notes khole hi nahi.
Meeko ulta hai. Pehle tumhare notes padhta hai — tab bolta hai.
Andar machine simple hai. Notes ke tukde — har tukda page-tagged. Sawaal aate hi sahi tukde nikalte hain — phir Gemma jawab likhta hai — aur code har quote verify karta hai.
Quiz mein galat jawab? Meeko sirf cross nahi lagata — sahi jawab, saboot, aur hint deta hai.
Aur jab jawab notes mein nahi — Meeko guess nahi karta. Saaf kehta hai: NOT FOUND.
Ask. Quiz. Flashcards. Audio overview. Sab tumhare notes se. Meeko — learn from your notes. Verify every answer.

bgm.blob: Generic chatbots invent answers; Meeko answers only from your notes — with proof.
